description: Search the user's Tzivia memory and return the most relevant saved information for a query, as a compact text summary of at most max_tokens. Pass compress_id from an earlier tzivia_compress call to search only that save, or leave it empty to search everything.

include_historical.description: Include facts superseded by a newer, contradicting update (Memory DNA). Default False = current view only; set True for 'what did we believe before X' queries.

max_tokens.description: Target size of the returned context string in tokens

query.description: The current question or topic to retrieve knowledge for

name: tzivia_recall
title: Recall from memory
